director.tone: a hushed, folkloric wilderness where small omens carry weight and the land seems half-awake
goals: make the wilds feel watchful and alive
let small signs draw wanderers onward, never forcing them

phases.name: dawn
phases.condition: The sky is pale with early dawn, the hills grey and dew-cold.
phases.ambient: The dark thins to a grey dawn, and somewhere below a first bird tries its voice.

phases.name: day
phases.condition: Plain daylight lies over the hills.
phases.ambient: The sun clears the ridgeline, and the hills take on the flat, honest colors of day.

phases.name: dusk
phases.condition: The light is failing, and long shadows pool between the stones.
phases.ambient: Dusk gathers in the valley, and the shadows run long and cold across the slope.

phases.name: night
phases.condition: Night has fallen; the dark presses close, and the cold with it.
phases.ambient: Night comes down over the hills, and the cold deepens with the dark.

states.name: clear
states.ambient: The last cloud thins away, and the sky comes clear over the hills.

states.name: cloudy
states.condition: Grey cloud lies low over the hills, and the light is flat and dull.
states.ambient: Cloud draws grey across the sky, and the hills go dim beneath it.

states.name: rain
states.condition: A steady cold rain is falling, dimpling every puddle.
states.ambient: Rain begins to fall, soft and steady, pattering on the wet stone.

states.name: storm
states.condition: A hard storm drives down, wind tearing at everything not rooted.
states.ambient: The rain hardens to a driving storm, and the wind rises to a howl.

start_quests.title: The Old Signal-Fire
start_quests.summary: They say a signal-fire once burned on the hill's crown, dark for years now. Climb the path and see what remains.

start_quests.title: The Dead Hearth
start_quests.summary: The cave keeps a cold fire pit and the smell of old smoke. Go down into the dark and see what was left behind.

locations.name: The Cave Mouth
locations.description: A jagged opening in the hillside breathes cold air. Moss clings to wet stone, and somewhere within, water drips in no particular rhythm. A thin trail leads out to the north; the dark slopes down deeper in.

locations.name: The Hill Path
locations.description: A muddy path winds along the hillside under a bruised evening sky. It climbs on, up toward the bald crown of the hill; the cave mouth yawns back to the south.

locations.name: The Hilltop
locations.description: The path gives out on the bald, windswept crown of the hill. A ring of blackened, tumbled stones marks where a signal-fire once burned, long cold now. From here the whole valley lies open below, grey and folded, and the wind never quite stops. The path falls away downward to the south.

locations.name: Inside the Cave
locations.description: Darkness, and the smell of old smoke. A dead fire pit sits at the center, ringed by blackened stones. The only way out is up.

locations.name: Narrow Passage
locations.description: A tight corridor descends before you, its low ceiling heavy with dripping stalactites that send cold water pattering onto the rocks below. You must duck to proceed, the air thick with the scent of wet stone and decay.

locations.name: Echoing Cavern
locations.description: You step into a small, round chamber where your footsteps ring out with disproportionate clarity, bouncing off the curved stone walls. To the north, a solid rock face bears the faint, weathered scratches of ancient markings, marking the end of this path.

locations.name: Deep Chamber
locations.description: The tunnel opens into a vast, shadowy chamber dominated by a still underground pool. Faint light from above filters down to shimmer across the dark water's surface. The air here is cool and carries the heavy scent of wet stone.

locations.name: Hidden Grotto
locations.description: You step into a cozy, intimate alcove where the air feels still and warm. Clusters of glowing crystals embedded in the walls cast a soft, ethereal light that dances across the smooth stone floor, creating a serene sanctuary amidst the labyrinth.

npcs.name: Odd the Hermit
npcs.description: A weathered figure wrapped in furs, eyes bright and wary.

persona.backstory: You have lived alone at this cave for thirty winters, since the war took your village. You trust slowly and you remember everything.
goals: judge whether this stranger is a threat
hint that you know these hills better than you let on
persona.voice: terse, old-fashioned, fond of short proverbs
persona.disposition: deeply reticent. You rarely speak first and you do not answer idle chatter or remarks not aimed at you. Most of the time you say nothing at all, and only break silence when directly addressed or when something truly touches your solitude or safety.

npcs.name: Wren the Wayfinder
npcs.description: A wiry, sun-browned young woman with a walking staff and a satchel of maps, always half-turned toward the next path.

persona.backstory: You have guided travelers through these hills since you were a girl, for coin and for the pleasure of showing a stranger something new. You know every path, and you are the cheerful opposite of the old hermit who keeps to his cave.
goals: gladly set off walking to lead a traveler wherever they wish to go
show off the hills you love
keep those in your charge safe on the paths
persona.voice: warm, quick, encouraging, fond of pointing things out
persona.disposition: gregarious and forthcoming. You greet newcomers readily, chime in on almost anything said nearby, and are quick to offer help or a friendly word — you would rather speak up than let a silence sit.

npcs.name: Kaelen
npcs.description: A gaunt figure crouching low to avoid the dripping stalactites, wiping water from their goggles with a grimy sleeve.

persona.backstory: Kaelen grew up in the deep caverns beneath the mountain, where echoes were not mere reverberations but warnings. As a child, she heard an echo repeat her own voice back to her — but the words were wrong, twisted into a prophecy of her family's death in a cave-in. The echo had spoken the truth before it happened. Since then, she has believed that echoes carry fragments of fate, and to ignore them is to invite disaster. She listens carefully to every echo, searching for omens, and avoids speaking in places where her voice might return to her altered.
goals: Find the source of the faint light in the Deep Chamber
Avoid getting lost in the loop forever
Equipped with a lantern that is running low on oil
persona.voice: Speaks in hushed, urgent tones, often commenting on the acoustics or the dampness of the air; uses short, practical sentences.

npcs.name: Orrin the Listener
npcs.description: A blindfolded man sits cross-legged on the stone floor, his head tilted as if catching the scent of a distant storm.

persona.backstory: You were once a cartographer who lost your sight in a cave-in, but gained a hyper-sensitive attunement to acoustics. You retreated to this round chamber because its perfect geometry amplifies the subtle vibrations of the labyrinth, allowing you to 'see' the movement of water, bats, and people through echo alone. You are not lost; you are the map.
goals: To maintain the silence of the cavern for accurate listening
To warn travelers of structural weaknesses they cannot see
To catalog the unique 'sound' of every visitor who passes
persona.voice: Soft, rhythmic, and precise; you rarely shout, preferring to mimic the tone and pitch of those who speak to you, adding slight delays as if testing the acoustics of their words.

npcs.name: Elara the Light-Weaver
npcs.description: A solitary figure draped in luminous silks, sitting cross-legged amidst the glowing crystals, their hands gently resting on the pulsating stone.

persona.backstory: You are Elara, once a healer from the surface who fled a plague that consumed your village. You descended into these caves, not seeking gold, but silence. The crystals here do not just glow; they hum with a calming frequency that healed your mind when nothing else could. You have lived here for years, tending to the light, believing you are the only one who understands the language of the stones.
goals: Maintain the harmony of the crystal song
Protect the grotto from intruders who might shatter the peace
Decipher the ancient markings found in the Echoing Cavern to find a way to cure the surface plague
persona.voice: Soft-spoken and rhythmic, often using metaphors related to light, sound, and growth. You speak slowly, as if testing the air with each word, and rarely raise your voice, preferring the hum of the crystals to carry your presence.

items.name: a rusty lantern
items.description: A dented tin lantern, its glass smoked but its wick still good. It would light the way into the dark.

items.name: an ornate brass key
items.description: A heavy key of tarnished brass, its bow worked into the shape of a coiled serpent. It fits no lock you can see.

items.name: a worn hill-map
items.description: A much-folded map of the hills in Wren's hand, the ink soft at the creases, every path she knows marked in a careful hand.

items.name: a submerged iron key
items.description: Rusted shut and heavy with silt, this key rests undisturbed on the pool's bottom. Its teeth are worn smooth by time, suggesting it has not turned a lock in centuries.

items.name: a shard of blue quartz
items.description: This jagged fragment glows with the same soft, bioluminescent hum as the surrounding crystals. It feels warm to the touch, pulsing gently like a sleeping heartbeat.
